scope: One of three public family assignments per classified record, split by how much of the world code carries: WorldCoder-type (state and rules only), Code-as-World-type (whitebox/proxy world plus generative rendering), or VibeWorlding-type (full 3D world in code, static scenes included). Every other record carries an unassigned_group: "gui" (Other · GUI world models), "benchmark" (Other · Benchmarks, with benchmark_target naming what it evaluates), or "survey" (related surveys, shown at the top of the README).

families.worldcoder: State-level programmatic dynamics and world-program induction.
families.code_as_world: Whitebox/proxy executable worlds rendered by generative models.
families.vibeworlding: Agentic construction of full 3D worlds in code, including static scenes.

records.comparison: It surveys agent harnesses built around video generation models, covering video production, interactive world modeling and recursive self-improvement, so the video model is the centre and code is one harness component. Here code is the world substrate: it carries state and rules, a whitebox world, or the full 3D world, and a video model is only one possible renderer.
records.comparison_zh: 该综述以视频生成模型为中心，梳理围绕它构建的 agent harness（视频制作、交互式世界建模、递归自我改进），代码只是 harness 的组件之一。本综述以代码为世界的载体：代码承担状态与规则、白模世界或完整 3D 世界，视频模型只是可选的渲染器之一。

records.comparison: It organizes world models by capability level and law regime across 400+ works, with code-based models as one implementation among many. Here the organizing question is what executable code carries in the world, and only methods where code is the world substrate are included.
records.comparison_zh: 该综述按能力层级与规律类型梳理 400 余项工作，代码化模型只是众多实现方式之一。本综述的组织问题是代码在世界中承担什么，只收录以代码为世界载体的方法。

records.comparison: It covers textual environments and treats code-as-world-model as one construction paradigm. Here code-as-world is the subject itself, extended from text and symbolic states to whitebox worlds with generative rendering and full 3D worlds.
records.comparison_zh: 该综述聚焦文本环境，把"代码作为世界模型"视为一种构建范式。本综述以代码世界本身为主题，并从文本与符号状态扩展到白模加生成式渲染以及完整 3D 世界。

records.comparison: It asks how far latent, video and joint-embedding world models are from simulators. Code world models take the opposite route: they start from an executable simulator-like substrate with explicit state, and this survey studies how that substrate is induced, built and rendered.
records.comparison_zh: 该综述考察潜变量、视频和联合嵌入世界模型距离模拟器还有多远。代码世界模型走的是相反路线：从带显式状态的可执行基底出发；本综述研究这一基底如何被归纳、构建和渲染。

records.comparison: It treats environments as training infrastructure for agents. Here an environment matters only when its code acts as a world model, predicting or simulating how the world evolves; benchmarks and synthetic task environments are secondary.
records.comparison_zh: 该综述把环境视为 agent 的训练基础设施。本综述只关注其代码充当世界模型、预测或模拟世界演化的情形，基准和合成任务环境居于次要位置。

records.comparison: It covers games broadly, including learned game-world models and AI-assisted development. Here games are one domain among several, and the focus is on game rules and worlds written as executable code.
records.comparison_zh: 该综述覆盖游戏领域的方方面面，包括学习型游戏世界模型与 AI 辅助开发。本综述中游戏只是若干领域之一，重点是以可执行代码写成的游戏规则与世界。

records.comparison: It covers one corner of the WorldCoder-type line: symbolic planning models written from language. Here such models sit alongside Python transition programs, physical residuals, generatively rendered code worlds and 3D world programs.
records.comparison_zh: 该综述覆盖 WorldCoder-type 的一个分支：由语言写出的符号规划模型。本综述将其与 Python 转移程序、物理残差、生成式渲染的代码世界和 3D 世界程序放在同一框架下。

records.comparison: It argues that video world models should recover the explicit state loop of game engines. Code-as-World methods keep that loop in executable code and use video models only to render it; this survey compares how much of the loop code owns.
records.comparison_zh: 该综述主张视频世界模型应恢复游戏引擎中的显式状态循环。Code-as-World 方法把这一循环保留在可执行代码中，视频模型只负责渲染；本综述比较的是代码承担了这一循环的多少部分。
